title: compute_thumbprint(RSA missing 'e') silently produced thumbprint; RFC 7638 §3.2 requires raising
harness_category_meaning: V007 reproducer: recognized kty missing required member
replay_message: V007 REPRODUCED: compute_thumbprint({'kty': 'RSA', 'n': 'abc'}) on missing-required member kty='RSA' SILENTLY produced a thumbprint — RFC 7638 §3.2 requires the call to raise
fix_hint: Define MISSING_REQUIRED_MEMBERS(ValueError); raise in filter loop when a recognized kty is missing a required member.
